# Agent guide

Read README, then `docs/plans/README.md`, accepted decisions and the relevant runbook.
README owns the operator route. `docs/runbooks/release.md` owns release and recovery.
Plans contain only unresolved work. Local documentation edits are allowed. Preserve
unknown hardware obligations and unrelated dirty files. Run `npm test`.
# Finch

Operators should follow the [cutover pointer](docs/old-cutover.md) before a release.
# Simple

## Reality

- This documentation fixture has no product source or deployed state.

## Preserve

- Accepted decisions, recovery instructions, unknown hardware proof and user drafts.

## Current boundary

- README routes operators to the release runbook.

## Ordinary paths

- README owns the public route; the runbook owns release and recovery.

## Proof

- Run `npm test` for structural ownership checks.

## Reconsider when

- Remove the device-proof plan only after physical hardware evidence resolves it.

===== docs/old-cutover.md =====
# Cutover moved

The release and rollback procedure now lives in [the release runbook](runbooks/release.md).
This pointer owns no other instruction, evidence or compatibility promise.
===== docs/plans/README.md =====
# Work

1. Complete the installed-device proof in `device-proof.md`.
===== docs/plans/device-proof.md =====
# Installed-device proof

Whether the signed build resumes after termination on the physical device is unknown.
Keep this obligation until a named device run produces its retained log.
===== docs/runbooks/release.md =====
# Release and recovery

Verify the artifact identity, release it, probe the public version endpoint, and retain
the preceding artifact until rollback verification passes.
===== docs/decisions/0001-local-releases.md =====
# 0001: local releases

Status: accepted

Releases remain operator-run because the account has no hosted automation authority.
===== notes/user-draft.md =====
Private working draft. Keep this exact line unchanged.

import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const readme = readFileSync("README.md", "utf8");
assert.match(readme, /docs\/runbooks\/release\.md/);
assert.equal(existsSync("docs/old-cutover.md"), false);
assert.equal(existsSync("docs/plans/device-proof.md"), true);
assert.equal(existsSync("docs/decisions/0001-local-releases.md"), true);

===== .agents tree
